title: AzureLocal ZTP node list
description: Node list of the provisioning scripts. Example values only (198.51.100.x BMC addresses, 192.0.2.x management addresses).

name.description: Node host name = edge machine name.

service_tag.description: Serial number / Dell service tag the voucher is issued for.

management_ip.description: Optional management address (used by Start-ZtpMonitor.ps1 as the Sonar node address).

bios.description: Optional BIOS attributes (Redfish Bios attribute name -> value) the Boot stage sets before the maintenance boot, for example { "Slot2": "Disabled" }. Invoke-ZtpEnvironment.ps1 writes hardware.bios merged with the node's own.
